Metadata.title: Quran Learning Platform
Metadata.description: Quran memorization and revision tracking for teachers and parents

Home.title: Quran Learning Platform
Home.subtitle: Record your students' memorization and revision in seconds, and let parents follow their progress.
Home.headline: Quran memorization, recorded in seconds
Home.feature_fast_desc: Surah, rating and next passage, filled in for you.
Home.feature_parents_desc: Invite by WhatsApp or QR; they see only their child.
Home.feature_offline_desc: Your entry is kept on the phone and saved later.
Home.feature_private_desc: Each circle’s data is separate. No ads, ever.
